quantities.T1_wall: cycles an op, the slowest minion: forecast cycles_per_op_wall / cyc_op_max - 1
quantities.T2_counter_mean: the counter's mean cycles an op: forecast cycles_per_op_mean / cyc_op_mean - 1
quantities.T3_seconds: seconds a pass (one GEMM): 64 MB NB KB x T_forecast(us) x 1e-6 / t_pass_s - 1 (the host's ops a minion a pass); at the measured clock T3 equals T1 identically (the reducer's T_op_us = wall / ops): both printed
quantities.E1_J_over_idle_given_t: W over idle at the measured op time, W = A + B / t_meas (the predictor's W_affine at the run's conditions) against the primary view's dP_w; relative (= J over idle given t) when the case's mean MM1-v3.2 W given t and its mean measured dP_w are both 3 W or more; else a WATTS case scored in watts (E215's form; the watts set fixed by MM1-v3.2 and the measurement, the same for every model)
quantities.E2_J_over_idle_t_forecast: (W_fc x T_fc) / (dP_w x t_meas) - 1, W_fc at the model's own op time; at a watts case W_fc - dP_w
quantities.E3_J_at_rest_given_t: (P_rest + W given t) / (P_rest + dP_w) - 1, P_rest = p_mean_w - dP_w (the run's rest, measured, given)
quantities.E4_J_at_rest_t_forecast: (P_rest + W_fc) x T_fc / ((P_rest + dP_w) x t_meas) - 1
quantities.split: per card; per format and kind; per class (MASK, CELL1, KB1, L2I8, MQ3, DK, HLD, BW, NB1, ANCHOR); FULL and SUB; configuration twins apart (section c)

forecast_procedure.footing_1_measured: THE PRIMARY FOOTING: each frozen predictor unchanged at each run's measured conditions, read from the data's start-of-run records only (MM1's README section 5 form, as unread-e214, decl-e217 and decl-e219 did): the primary view's kernel clock kclock_mhz; minion volts: card 1 the models' footing 0.517 V, the governed cards the primary view's rails.minion.mV / 1000 (else the model's own volts at f); the governed base by the model's own G_of_f(card, f); the run's die_start_c (50 C when absent). The terms, controls and candidates on their base model's forecast at the same conditions; their features are configuration-only (steps 2w, 2f)
forecast_procedure.fields_read_before_scoring: from each committed E221 data JSON ONLY: the top-level card, session and primary_view, and per run: run, i, ran, role, arm, values, type, shires, minions, die_start_c, arm_token, arm_family, ops_pass, ops_pass_ok, and the primary view's kclock_mhz and rails.minion.mV. No time, cycles, power, energy or seconds field is read until the forecasts at those conditions are hashed
forecast_procedure.footing_2_nominal: the nominal forecasts frozen now (section h), scored beside by the same rules (REPORTED)
forecast_procedure.counts_as_inputs: the switch counts are inputs, never fitted: each model's own tables (MM1-v3.1 and MM1-v3.2: MM1-v3's rows + counts 3e8991d0; counts-e214); E221's kinds (zeros, ones, random) are committed kinds with committed counts; E221 designs no tile, so counts-e217's rows are not needed and no count is made
forecast_procedure.order: 0 the work copies -> 1 this declaration hashed -> 2 the nominal forecasts hashed -> FROZEN.txt (no step 4: no counts); after the data: the conditions read -> the measured-conditions forecasts hashed -> the scorer hashed -> the read and the scores

metric.error: forecast / measured - 1 (the MM1 convention); rms % and signed mean (bias) %; watts cases rms and mean in W
metric.case: a case's error = the mean of its runs' errors (each run at its own conditions); per-run figures REPORTED beside
metric.twins: per model: a time case is a twin when (card, kernel, arm, format, mask, the mean of its runs' measured clocks to 25 MHz) is in that model's TRAINING time configurations (its landed out/points_time_*.csv; E146 store rungs out); an energy case when that key and its kind are in its energy configurations (work/step1/twin-keys.json, 3bfd3883); the no-twin cases carry the pass rule and the headline; twins and all cases printed beside. At the nominal clocks (a preview; the measured clock decides): MM1-v3.2 35 time / 31 energy twins of 733, MM1-v3.1 17 / 15, MM1-v3 17 / 15, MM1-v2 8 / 8

comparisons.test: the exact two-sided sign test (binomial at 1/2) on the untied cases, alpha 0.05: A BETTER if p < 0.05 and A is closer in more cases; B BETTER the other way; NOT DECIDED otherwise; TOO FEW under 10 untied cases; NO DATA with none
comparisons.d: per case d = |ln(1 + e_B)| - |ln(1 + e_A)| (A closer when d > tie); at a watts case |dW_B| - |dW_A| in W; over every case both price (twins included); REPORTED beside over the cases that are twins for neither

pass_rule.part_A: MM1-v3.2 on the PRIMARY footing by E215's rule form on each card over its NO-TWIN cases (every class): a case passes T1, T2, T3, E3, E4 when |error| is within the band, E1, E2 when |error| is within the band or, at a watts case, |watts difference| within the watts band; a rule PASSES when at least 90% of its cases pass, FAILS otherwise, TOO FEW under 10 cases, NO DATA with none. PART A PASSES when no rule FAILS on any card and at least one rule PASSES; FAILS when any rule fails (named); else NOT DECIDED

pass_rule.verdict: PASS when part A passes; FAIL when it fails (named); NOT DECIDED otherwise. Decided by a script: blind-e221's scorer (the scripts of the lane that scores E221), implementing this declaration's sections exactly, code-tested on a stand-in day built from the frozen forecasts alone, and hashed (sha256 in its progress log, posted with the result) BEFORE its first read of any E221 measurement; a departure from this declaration is a dated amendment hashed before that read. The nominal footing (section h) by the same script and rules beside, REPORTED. A session that does not run, or runs short, is scored on what ran; a card with no session is NO DATA
